title: Site & Domains
description: The branded page your forms are published on: address, branding, default form and domains.
readOnly: Only administrators can change site settings.

address.title: Address
address.description: Your platform subdomain always works; links use the verified primary domain when there is one.
address.subdomainHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 3–40 characters.

brand.title: Branding
brand.description: Shown in the hosted form page header and the browser tab. Each form's own theme still applies.
brand.name: Display name

defaultForm.title: Default form
defaultForm.description: The site root (/) shows this form. Without one, the root returns 404.
defaultForm.label: Form
defaultForm.noPublished: No published forms. Publish a form first.

seo.title: Search & sharing
seo.description: Empty fields fall back to the form name.

legal.title: Legal links
legal.description: Shown in the page footer. Must start with https.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Publish your forms on your own domain (e.g. quote.yourcompany.com).
domains.hostnameHelp: Only subdomains are supported; an apex domain (yourcompany.com) cannot carry a CNAME record.
domains.addDescription: After adding the domain, create the records below at your DNS provider.
domains.dnsDescription: Verification advances automatically once the records propagate; this can take a few minutes.
domains.removeDescription: {{hostname}} will no longer show your forms. Links using this address will stop working.

failure.dns_mismatch: The CNAME record does not point to {{target}} or the TXT verification record is missing. Check the records and retry.
failure.ssl_failed: The SSL certificate could not be issued. If the domain has a CAA record, allow our platform and retry.

validation.subdomain: Enter a valid subdomain (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; 3–40 characters).
validation.subdomainReserved: This subdomain is reserved by the platform.
validation.httpsUrl: Enter a valid address starting with https://.
validation.apex: Apex domains cannot be added; use a subdomain such as quote.yourcompany.com.
